metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the IGES 5.3 CLI tool in Node.js (stdlib-only) under `output/`.

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (runnable as `node output/main.js ...`)
- Binary name: `output/iges` (shebang wrapper; supports `iges parse|write|query|eval|roundtrip ...`)
- Core modules:
  - `output/iges_parse.js` (fixed-format parser + validations/diagnostics)
  - `output/iges_write.js` (80-column writer; deterministic; null-string handling; correct DE layout)
  - `output/entities.js` (87-type entity PD catalog parse/write)
  - `output/eval.js` (curve/surface eval + transformation application)
  - `output/diag.js`, `output/free_format.js`, `output/ascii.js`

Quick sanity checks (already run): parse/write/eval on a sample file, and `roundtrip` fixed-point byte identity across two passes.
